model: Ti-Hawk Titanium Dirt Jump Frame Set
description:
Ride the Legacy. Own the Sky.

Introducing the Ti-Hawk — the titanium evolution of Airborne’s legendary Skyhawk dirt jumper. Born from BMX roots and proven on the world stage, this isn’t just an upgrade. It’s the frame that won the first-ever UCI Pump Track World Championship in 2019 (plus countless pro wins) — now hand made in premium 3Al-2.5V tubing and 3D Printed 6Al-4V Turbine Titanium headtube and chain stay yoke for riders who demand bombproof durability, buttery compliance, and a ride that feels alive.

The original aluminum Skyhawk was engineered from the ground up with input from Airborne’s elite team riders. Its geometry dominated pump tracks, dirt jumps, and ramps worldwide:

UCI World Champ geometry — Winning frame design delivered lightning-quick handling, perfect pop, and rail-like stability.

BMX-bred DNA — 26" wheels, short cockpit, and that unmistakable pump-track flow. Riders called it “hyped,” “ready out of the box,” and “a skills-building weapon” — from Reddit dirt-jumpers to pro pump-track finals.

The Skyhawk wasn’t just a bike. It was a statement: Airborne’s BMX heritage meets modern dirt-jump precision. And it delivered — podiums, world titles, and garage legends everywhere.

Refined championship-winning geometry. Same addictive pop and precision. Now in titanium — the material that pros dream about for a reason:

Feather-light yet bombproof durability — Expect sub-20 lb builds that still eat abuse, No rust, no fatigue cracks. This frame will outlive every aluminum bike you’ve ever owned.

Natural damping — Titanium’s inherent flex smooths landings and chatter without sacrificing snap. Pump tracks feel glued. Big hits feel controlled.

Premium feel, zero compromises — Tapered headtube, zero-stack headset compatibility, and that signature Airborne ride quality — now with the compliant, lively soul only titanium delivers.

VectorLoc ™ adjustable dropout system — 6 positions let you tune chainstay length, tire clearance, and frame geometry; from aggressive to stretched geometry, delivering the perfect balance for any mission.

Advanced hydroformed titanium T/T and D/T — precisely engineered shapes for superior stiffness where you need it, compliance where you want it, and a strikingly modern, aggressive aesthetic.

SLM 3D Printed Grade 5 (6Al/4V) Titanium, Vacuum Annealed frame components: Turbine Headtube, Chainstay Yoke

Generous tire clearance — of up to 2.4", ready for fast-rolling pump track slicks or high-volume DJ setups

Dropper post compatible 31.6mm native seat post diameter or convert to a 27.2mm with the included seat post shim adapter.

26" Native wheel size, also compatible with 27.5"

Whether you’re chasing UCI-level pump-track glory, sessioning backyard dirt jumps, or building your ultimate skills bike, the Ti-Hawk is the titanium crown jewel of the Skyhawk bloodline.
